heroHeadline: CENTCOM: 19M Barrels Shipped Through Hormuz as Iran Intensifies Vessel Attacks
heroSubtitle: US Central Command data shows 19 million barrels transited the Strait of Hormuz despite Iran escalating attacks on shipping, directly refuting Iranian claims of effective waterway control
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
